_about: The proposed questions — one orchestrator each (Orchestrator rule 1, 2026-09-13). Hand-kept: the judgement half of the map. Everything else on the map is generated from the master, the census and the code by build-orchestrator-map.py. A row here is a PROPOSAL until the founder marks it on the map.

questions.question: What am I worth — in total, by class, by institution, by tax bucket, and how it has moved
questions.note: Home's card, the Net worth tab and Insights' totals are one question (rule 1). Other investments (MN-M-022/023) are a class inside it, not a question of their own — recommendation, for your ruling. Prices-updated (HM-M-001) rides with it as the freshness of the same balances. FOUNDER 2026-09-27 (answering his own question on this row): the Alternatives screen belongs here only for its TOTAL VALUE (MK-MN-M-022), which is the Alternatives slice of net worth and must equal what the Net worth tab shows for that class. EST. GROWTH /year (MK-MN-M-023) is a projection, not a worth figure, and was moved OUT of this question on his "ok".

questions.question: What came in and what went out this month, and the surplus that leaves — planned and actual
questions.note: READ FROM THE APPROVED DESIGN, 2026-09-28, after the founder corrected me: "this month is actual - and as we decided it is not three number it is spelling out all flow to calculate surplus... Expense tab is listing transaction details. Are you working of latest approved screens or older one?" I was not. The approved design is moneykeel_pres_mock_cash-flow-this-month-and-expenses_v07 (2026-09-26), and it says: THIS MONTH spells out EVERY row twice — Planned (Inflow · Mortgage · Car · Expenses/your budget · HELOC · the card payment · = Planned surplus) and Actual (Actual inflow · Mortgage paid · Car loan due · Expenses entered by hand · Expenses imported from your card · HELOC · the card payment · = Actual surplus so far). EXPENSES is not a second question: it is the DETAIL BEHIND ONE ROW of that flow — monthly recurring, planned by category, actual by source (by hand, imported, debt payments counted as expenses), and the big-ticket radar that says which debt payments are counted. Part and whole, like basePay inside incomeSummary — NOT two rival answers. C-2 is withdrawn.
